The Fast and Furious Mitsubishi Eclipse tribute is one of the best early rides in GTA 6, and you can take it for free.

The car is locked in a garage on Vespucci Island, one of the Rialto Islands to the west of Vice Beach.

Head to the garage, break in, and switch off the alarm on the wall to your left.

If you take it in Chapter 1, you lose it again once you die or get busted, because only your personal vehicle is kept.
